chapters.chapter_title: My Class Is Behind the Office

questions.text: The classroom is behind the office. Where is the classroom?
questions.discussion: Kalimat menyatakan bahwa ruang kelas berada **behind the office** atau di belakang kantor.

questions.text: The gate is in front of the school. Where is the gate?
questions.discussion: **In front of** berarti di depan.

questions.text: The library is beside the office. What is beside the office?
questions.discussion: Yang disebut berada di sebelah kantor adalah **the library**.

questions.text: The canteen is between the library and the office. Where is the canteen?
options: between the library and the office
questions.answer: between the library and the office
questions.discussion: **Between** menunjukkan posisi di tengah dua tempat.

questions.text: The pencil is in the pencil case. Where is the pencil?
questions.discussion: **In** berarti di dalam suatu tempat atau wadah.

questions.text: The book is on the desk. Where is the book?
questions.discussion: **On the desk** berarti berada di atas permukaan meja.

questions.text: The bag is under the chair. Which word tells its position?
questions.discussion: **Under** berarti di bawah.

questions.text: A: Where is the laboratory? B: It is beside the parking area. Which place is beside the parking area?
questions.discussion: Jawaban B menyebutkan bahwa laboratorium berada di sebelah area parkir.

questions.text: Which question asks about the location of the office?
questions.discussion: Kata tanya **where** digunakan untuk menanyakan letak.

questions.text: Complete the dialogue. A: Where is the library? B: ___ behind the canteen.
questions.discussion: Untuk menjawab letak satu tempat, pola yang tepat adalah **It is ...**.

questions.text: The office is in front of the classroom. Complete the sentence: The classroom is ___ the office.
questions.discussion: Jika kantor berada di depan kelas, kelas berada **behind** atau di belakang kantor.

questions.text: The mosque is between the canteen and the restroom. Which places are on the two sides of the mosque?
options: the classroom and the parking area
questions.discussion: Dua tempat yang menjadi acuan kata **between** adalah kantin dan toilet.

questions.text: Which sentence uses **between** correctly?
options: The gate is between the office and the library.
The gate is between the office.
questions.answer: The gate is between the office and the library.
questions.discussion: **Between** memerlukan dua acuan yang dihubungkan dengan **and**.

questions.text: Which sentence tells that the ball is below the table?
options: The ball is on the table.
The ball is in the table.
The ball is under the table.
The ball is beside the table.
questions.answer: The ball is under the table.
questions.discussion: Posisi di bawah dinyatakan dengan **under**.

questions.text: Which sentence tells that the eraser touches the top of the book?
options: The eraser is behind the book.
The eraser is on the book.
The eraser is under the book.
The eraser is between two books.
questions.answer: The eraser is on the book.
questions.discussion: **On** menunjukkan benda berada di atas dan menyentuh permukaan.

questions.text: A: Where is the teacher room? B: It is ___ the office. They are side by side.
questions.discussion: Dua tempat yang berdampingan dinyatakan dengan **beside**.

questions.text: The flagpole is in front of the library. What is behind the flagpole?
questions.discussion: Jika tiang bendera di depan perpustakaan, perpustakaan berada di belakang tiang bendera.

questions.text: Choose the correct order to make a sentence: **is – The cat – the chair – under**.
options: The cat under is the chair.
Is the cat the chair under.
The cat is under the chair.
Under the cat is chair the.
questions.answer: The cat is under the chair.
questions.discussion: Urutan kalimat yang tepat adalah subjek + **is** + kata posisi + tempat.

questions.text: The ruler is between the book and the pencil case. Which object is in the middle?
questions.discussion: Benda yang disebut sebelum **between** adalah benda yang berada di tengah.

questions.text: Which answer matches the question, “Where is the canteen?”
options: It is beside the parking area.
I eat rice in the canteen.
questions.answer: It is beside the parking area.
questions.discussion: Pertanyaan **where** dijawab dengan keterangan letak.

questions.text: Complete the question: “___ is the restroom?”
questions.discussion: **Where is the restroom?** berarti “Di mana toilet?”

questions.text: The cat is behind the chair. Which sentence has the opposite position?
options: The cat is in front of the chair.
The cat is under the chair.
The cat is on the chair.
The cat is between two chairs.
questions.answer: The cat is in front of the chair.
questions.discussion: Lawan posisi **behind** adalah **in front of**.

questions.text: The office is beside the laboratory. Which sentence has the same meaning?
options: The office is under the laboratory.
The office is next to the laboratory.
The office is behind the laboratory.
The office is in the laboratory.
questions.answer: The office is next to the laboratory.
questions.discussion: **Beside** dan **next to** sama-sama berarti di sebelah. Kata target buku adalah **beside**.

questions.text: The ball is in the box. Which sentence is NOT correct?
options: The ball is inside the box.
The ball is in the box.
The ball is under the box.
questions.answer: The ball is under the box.
questions.discussion: **In the box** tidak sama dengan berada di bawah kotak.

questions.text: The grade 5 classroom is between the grade 4 and grade 6 classrooms. Which classroom is in the middle?
questions.discussion: Kalimat menempatkan kelas 5 di antara kelas 4 dan kelas 6.

questions.text: Choose the correct sentence.
options: The book are on the desk.
The book is on the desk.
The book on is the desk.
On the book the desk is.
questions.answer: The book is on the desk.
questions.discussion: Subjek tunggal **the book** memakai **is**.

questions.text: The parking area is behind the laboratory. Where is the laboratory compared with the parking area?
options: in front of the parking area
questions.answer: in front of the parking area
questions.discussion: Posisi kebalikan dari **behind** adalah **in front of**.

questions.text: Which word completes the sentence? “The shoes are ___ the table, not on it.”
questions.discussion: Petunjuk “not on it” dan letak di bawah meja sesuai dengan **under**.

questions.text: Read the two facts: The library is beside the office. The canteen is behind the office. Where is the canteen?
questions.discussion: Informasi kedua langsung menyebutkan letak kantin.

questions.text: A teacher puts a marker on the table. Which instruction matches the action?
options: Put the marker under the table.
Put the marker behind the table.
Put the marker on the table.
Put the marker between two tables.
questions.answer: Put the marker on the table.
questions.discussion: Meletakkan spidol di atas permukaan meja dinyatakan dengan **on the table**.

questions.text: Which sentence describes a room located at the back of the office?
options: The room is behind the office.
The room is in front of the office.
The room is on the office.
The room is under the office.
questions.answer: The room is behind the office.
questions.discussion: **At the back of** berarti **behind**.

questions.text: The teacher room and the office are side by side. Which sentence is correct?
options: The teacher room is behind the office.
The teacher room is beside the office.
The teacher room is under the office.
The teacher room is in the office.
questions.answer: The teacher room is beside the office.
questions.discussion: **Side by side** berarti berdampingan atau **beside**.

questions.text: A: Where is the ball? B: It is between the chair and the table. How many reference objects are mentioned?
questions.discussion: Dua benda acuan disebutkan, yaitu kursi dan meja.

questions.text: Choose the best Indonesian meaning of “The bag is beside the chair.”
questions.discussion: **Beside** berarti di sebelah.

questions.text: A: Where is your classroom? B: It is behind the office. What information does B give?
questions.discussion: Jawaban B memberikan informasi tentang letak ruang kelas.
